title: If It Had Happened Differently
grammar: Past Conditional (ha + múlt idő + volna) and Unfulfilled Past Obligation (kellett volna)
goal: I can say what would have happened if things had been different, using ha … volna.
I can express regret about the past with bárcsak … volna.
I can name a mistake and its consequence.
